source.initial_project_idea: A hair salon wants an online appointment booking system to reduce phone bookings, avoid double bookings, and allow customers to book services with available stylists online.

goals_and_objectives.statement: Reduce staff time spent handling appointment bookings by phone.
Allow customers to book hair salon appointments online.
Reduce appointment mistakes such as double bookings, wrong services, and incorrect times.

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow customers to view available hair salon services.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can view a list of salon services
Customer can see service name and estimated duration
Customer can see service price

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow customers to search available appointment slots by date, service, and stylist.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can select a date
Customer can select a service
Customer can select a stylist if available
System shows available appointment times

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow customers to book an available appointment online.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can choose an available appointment slot
Customer can enter contact details
System creates an appointment booking

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall prevent double bookings for the same stylist and time slot.
acceptance_criteria: System checks stylist availability before confirming an appointment
System does not allow two confirmed appointments for the same stylist at the same time

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall send appointment confirmation to the customer.
acceptance_criteria: Customer receives confirmation after booking
Confirmation includes service name, stylist name, appointment date, and appointment time

functional_requirements.statement: Reception staff shall be able to view and manage appointment bookings.
acceptance_criteria: Staff can view all appointments
Staff can search appointments by customer name or date
Staff can update appointment status

functional_requirements.statement: Stylists shall be able to view their own appointment schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Stylist can view upcoming appointments
Stylist can see customer name, service, and appointment time

functional_requirements.statement: The salon manager shall be able to manage services and stylist availability.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can add or update salon services
Manager can update service prices
Manager can update stylist working hours

non_functional_requirements.statement: The system should be easy for customers and staff to use.
The system should protect customer personal information.
The system should show available appointment slots quickly.
The system should keep appointment availability accurate.

data_requirements.name: Customer
data_requirements.purpose: Used to identify customers and send appointment confirmations.

data_requirements.name: Service
data_requirements.purpose: Used to display available salon services to customers.

data_requirements.name: Stylist
data_requirements.purpose: Used to match customers with available stylists.

data_requirements.name: Appointment
data_requirements.purpose: Used to record and manage salon appointments.

constraints.statement: The prototype will focus on online appointment booking, appointment management, service management, and stylist availability.
The system should be developed as a web-based prototype.
The prototype should be completed within one university semester.

success_criteria.statement: The system reduces the need for customers to phone the salon for appointment bookings.
success_criteria.measure: Compare number of phone bookings before and after system use.

success_criteria.statement: The system reduces double booking mistakes.
success_criteria.measure: Number of double booking incidents recorded.

success_criteria.statement: Customers can book appointments more conveniently online.
success_criteria.measure: Customer feedback after using the prototype.

priorities_and_preferences.statement: Viewing services, booking appointments, preventing double bookings, and sending confirmations are the highest priority features.
Stylist schedule view and manager reports are optional if time allows.

risks.statement: If stylist availability is not updated correctly, customers may still book unavailable time slots.
Customer personal data may be exposed if security is not handled properly.
Appointment duration may be incorrect if different services take different amounts of time.

assumptions.statement: Customers have internet access and are willing to book salon appointments online.
Salon staff will keep stylist availability and service details up to date.

resources.statement: Reception staff, stylists, and salon manager will provide feedback during testing.
A web development environment and database will be required for the prototype.
